prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production cutout-puppet PARTS ATLAS for Plum, the tiny moth courier in original mobile game Almost God.
Input image: the attached existing Plum character is the identity and material reference. Rebuild THIS SAME moth as nine SEPARATE paintable body pieces for animation, with no assembled extra character.
Canvas: square 1536 by 1536, a strict invisible 3 by 3 grid with generous transparent gutters. ONE isolated piece in each cell. No text, no grid lines. Genuine transparent alpha outside all pieces. Do not let pieces overlap cells.
Identity: adorable cream furry moth, huge glossy warm dark eyes, small smiling mouth, warm golden cream wings with pale circular markings and scalloped lobes, two curled copper-brown antennae, teal messenger satchel with a brass button and cross-body strap. Hand-painted storybook gouache, natural paper brush texture, crisp readable silhouettes.
Exact row 1, left to right:
1) HEAD only, face facing three-quarter to the right, full furry round head with a short furry neck, NO antennae, no body, no wings.
2) BODY only, fluffy cream thorax and tapered abdomen, NO head, NO antennae, NO wings, NO bag, NO feet. Rounded solid neck joint and solid side wing attachment areas, not hollow sockets.
3) LEFT wing assembly only: the larger left-side upper and lower moth wing lobes joined as one connected fan, cream-gold translucent painted membrane, no body. Wing root at the RIGHT edge of the piece.
Exact row 2, left to right:
4) RIGHT wing assembly only: smaller right-side upper and lower wing lobes joined as one fan, matching material, no body. Wing root at the LEFT edge of the piece.
5) LEFT curled copper-brown antenna only, rounded base at bottom, spiral tip at top.
6) RIGHT curled copper-brown antenna only, rounded base at bottom, spiral tip at top.
Exact row 3, left to right:
7) Teal satchel INCLUDING its long curved teal cross-body strap, brass button, no fur or body.
8) LEFT small brown insect hind foot/leg only, one gently bent slender leg with a solid upper attachment tip.
9) RIGHT small brown insect hind foot/leg only, corresponding opposite leg.
Constraints: Maintain exact character charm and colors. Wings have no antennae or face. Head has NO duplicate antennae. Body has no duplicate legs or bag. No human hands, no extra clothes, no added props, no complete assembled moth anywhere, no background scenery, no lettering, no watermark. Every limb has a solid painted overlap area for an animation joint.
